text_guide: 1. In Jellyfin open Dashboard → API keys and create a new key named "ioBroker". 2. Enter the address of your Jellyfin server and the key below. 3. Save – every Jellyfin app that connects to the server then appears as a device with its playback status and buttons. Tip for the Jellyfin app on phones: choose the web player in the app settings, otherwise the playback cannot be controlled remotely.
help_url: Address as you open it in the browser, incl. port, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8096
label_onlyRemote: Only show devices that can be controlled
help_onlyRemote: Many apps register twice with the server (app and player). With this option only the part that accepts commands is created.
help_updateInterval: How often the server sends the playback status (2–60 s)
help_coverHeight: Size of the cover images in pixels, 0 = original size
help_requestTimeout: Maximum wait time for an answer from the server
support_text: The adapter is free. If it is useful to you, you can support its development voluntarily.
